in_marathi.name: Amrapali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amrapali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amra (sky) + Pali (jewel). The name Amrapali is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'sky-jewel'. In Hindu mythology, Amrapali is a legendary courtesan who was enamored by the Buddha and offered him her devotion.
